SCGSim exposes the workflows below. A solver can support additional problem
types that SCGSim has not implemented. Select the calculation by the quantity
you need, then choose the appropriate source and boundary model.

::: {.table-responsive}

| Calculation | SCGSim backend | Input | Returned quantity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Electrostatic | Palace | GeometryPlan, terminal and ground Nets | Ordered capacitance matrix |
| Eigenmode | Palace | GeometryPlan, optional inductive ports | Mode frequency/native Q, energies; requested EPR |
| Eigenmode | HFSS | GDS mapping or source-first GeometryPlan | Mode frequency/native Q; requested EPR |
| Driven Modal | HFSS | GDS mapping and integration-line ports | Complex S-parameters, CSV and Touchstone |
| Driven Terminal | HFSS | GDS mapping and explicit reference conductors | Complex S-parameters, CSV and Touchstone |
| Finite 3D extraction | Q3D | Finite-thickness GDS imports and named nets | Native C/G and RL extraction matrices |
| Cross-section extraction | Q2D | Explicit rectangles and conductor groups | Per-unit-length C/G/L/R blocks |

:::

Palace Driven and Magnetostatic are not implemented; Meep is outside SCGSim's
scope. Palace's [native problem types](https://awslabs.github.io/palace/stable/guide/problem/)
include calculations beyond this table. The [PyAEDT user guide](https://aedt.docs.pyansys.com/version/stable/User_guide/index.html)
describes the underlying AEDT automation library.

## Energy participation and loss

Palace and HFSS Eigenmode support surface, bulk and inductive port/junction
analysis. A request selects quantities from the configured physical model;
it does not make missing channels zero. Surface films use explicit thickness,
permittivity and loss assumptions. AEDT surface estimates cover horizontal
top/bottom interfaces, not sidewall film energy. A reported known-loss subtotal
is therefore not automatically total device loss.

AEDT can evaluate EPR from retained native saved fields without a new eigensolve;
that operation still needs AEDT. Offline reanalysis changes attributed loss
assumptions on a recorded EPR result without native evaluation.

## Source and result differences

GeometryPlan is shared by Palace and source-first HFSS Eigenmode. Q3D uses its
own explicit imports/bindings; Q2D takes cross-section facts, not an inferred
slice. Shared source geometry does not equalize boundary conditions or make
lumped capacitance, resonance, S-parameters and per-length matrices interchangeable.
Use each result's units and native conductor/port/mode order.

The 1.1.0 candidate extends the Palace source path with explicitly authored
curves and caller-selected GDS boundary reconstruction. These inputs retain
their source Entity and occurrence identity and are lowered by in-tree SGB.
AEDT curve intent is unsupported. Palace `geometry_order` controls the
geometric mesh representation; it is separate from the FEM order used by the
field problem. Both controls and their returned mesh summary are still
converging, so they are not solver-accuracy recommendations.

Start with the [tutorials](examples.qmd). Exact supported requests are described
in [Palace Electrostatic](specs/palace-electrostatic-sgb.qmd),
[Palace Eigenmode](specs/palace-eigenmode.qmd), and
[AEDT runtime families](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd).
